prompt: Review whether NVIDIA has a material causal relationship to AI infrastructure power through compute demand, land and power guarantees, campus financing exposure and multi-generation hardware renewal; accept or reject the edge.

inputs.proposed_mechanism: NVIDIA can accelerate powered-campus deployment and sell successive compute generations, while capped land, power and shell guarantees transfer direct customer-credit, concentration and project-execution exposure to NVIDIA.
inputs.proposed_invalidation: Reject the positive channel if projects slip, guarantees crystallize without profitable hardware demand, customers cannot finance renewals, or power commitments fail to create material incremental NVIDIA economics.
